author: TheNotoriousMMA
text:
Back yourself. Do the work.

This is my mantra from here. 

Make it yours.

Talk is free. The work sends the invoice. No permission. No waiting to feel ready.

Back yourself in the dark. Do the work whether they see it or not. Then show up again like the job's not finished.

Believe it. Prove it. Repeat it.

☘️👊
